d:
Shai Gilgeous-Alexander put on a scoring masterclass, pouring in 43 points, 8 assists, 3 rebounds, and 4 three-pointers to lead the Oklahoma City Thunder to a hard-fought 117-112 victory over the Cleveland Cavaliers! SGA shot 14-of-35 from the field and recorded the 35th 40-point game of his career.
